label: NVR5232-16P-4KS2E 32-channel NVR with 16-port PoE
description: 32-channel 1U 4K NVR with two HDD bays, one gigabit uplink and sixteen 10/100 PoE camera ports (ports 1-8 also carry Dahua ePoE/EoC). Same 1U 16PoE chassis as the NVR5216-16P-4KS2E, with 32 recording channels rather than 16: 802.3af/at at 25.5 W per port and a 130 W total rated PoE budget.
notes: Dahua datasheet DHI-NVR5216/32-16P-4KS2E covers both SKUs on one sheet: Ordering Information lists DHI-NVR5216-16P-4KS2E as 16 channel and DHI-NVR5232-16P-4KS2E as 32 channel, both 1U 16PoE 4K&H.265 Pro NVRs. Network section: 1 x RJ-45 10/100/1000 Mbps, PoE 16 ports IEEE 802.3af/at with ports 1-8 supporting ePoE & EoC; Storage: 2 SATA III up to 10 TB each; 1 rear USB 3.0 + 1 front USB 2.0; RS232. The port hardware is therefore identical to the 5216 already in the catalogue - the only difference is channel count, which is a recording-capacity fact rather than a cabling one, so both are modelled with the same interfaces and only the label and description differ.
